name: taskflow
description: Production-style Next.js + Express monorepo used for codebase-interview practice

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @taskflow/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @taskflow/api" "npm run dev -w @taskflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @taskflow/api && npm run build -w @taskflow/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
